summary_en: Nihon M&A Center Holdings completed acquisition of AI Brain Partners (AIBP) through stock acquisition on October 1, 2026, and simplified share exchange effective November 2, 2026, making AIBP a wholly-owned subsidiary. 250,000 treasury shares were allocated to AIBP shareholders; no new shares were issued.
summary_jp: 10月1日の株式取得により議決権比率67.0％を確保した後、11月2日の簡易株式交換により完全子会社化が完了。対象企業の代表取締役社長と取締役は株式交換後も経営を継続。

name_jp: 日本Ｍ＆Ａセンターホールディングス
summary_en: Nihon M&A Center Holdings will acquire shares in AI Brain Partners (established September 2025) and complete its acquisition through simplified share exchange. AIBP specializes in supporting companies' in-house AI implementation and organizational transformation across four business lines. The acquisition aims to enhance group productivity through AI-driven business process optimization and expand customer value offerings with AI adoption support during M&A sourcing and post-merger integration phases.
summary_jp: 日本M&Aセンターが2025年9月設立のAIブレインパートナーズを株式取得と簡易株式交換により完全子会社化する。AIBP社はAI導入コンサルティングと組織改革支援の4事業を展開。グループの生産性向上とM&A仲介・PMI局面での顧客向けAI導入支援を目的とする。
